units.source_text: 归根到底，只有年事较长、见多识广、阅历丰富的人，逢到紧急关头才有办法。

en.t: In the end, only people who are older, well informed, and rich in experience know what to do in a crisis.

units.source_text: 现在源氏公子和惟光大夫都是年轻人，这时候毫无主意了。

en.t: But Prince Genji and Koremitsu were both young, and at this moment they had no idea what to do.

units.source_text: 还是惟光强些，他说：“这件事给这宅院里的人知道了，不当稳便。

en.t: Koremitsu was the steadier of the two, and he said, "It would not be safe for the people in this house to learn of this matter.

units.source_text: 这个守院人原是可靠的，但他的家眷也住在这里，他们知道了一定会泄露出去。

en.t: The caretaker himself is reliable enough, but his family lives here too, and if they find out, the news is sure to leak out.

units.source_text: 所以我们首先要离开这宅院。”

en.t: So first of all we must leave this house."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“可是，哪里有比这里人更少的地方呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "But where could there be a place with fewer people than here?"

units.source_text: 如果回到小姐本来的屋子里，那些侍女一定要哭。

en.t: If we go back to the lady's own rooms, those waiting women are sure to weep.

units.source_text: 那里人多，一定有许多邻人要责问，把消息传播到外间去。

en.t: There are many people there, and many neighbors would certainly ask questions and spread the news outside.

units.source_text: 最好到山中找个寺院，那里常常有人举行殡葬，我们夹在里头，没有人注目。”

en.t: It would be best to find a temple in the hills; funerals are often held there, and if we mingle among them, no one will notice us."

units.source_text: 他想了一会，又说：“从前我认识一个侍女，后来做了尼姑，迁居在东山那边。

en.t: After thinking for a while, he added, "Long ago I knew a waiting woman who later became a nun and moved over to Higashiyama.

units.source_text: 她是我父亲的乳母，现在衰老得很了，还住在那里。

en.t: She was my father's nurse; she is very old now, but she still lives there.

units.source_text: 东山来往的人很多，但她那里却非常清静。”

en.t: Many people come and go in Higashiyama, but her place is very quiet."

units.source_text: 此时天色将近黎明，惟光便吩咐准备车子。

en.t: By then the sky was nearly dawn, and Koremitsu ordered a carriage to be prepared.
